events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war has escalated, with multiple countries involved. The conflict is expected to impact global oil prices and geopolitical stability. The US and its allies are taking a strong stance against Iran.

actions.label: SHORT
actions.target: iShares Core US Aggregate Bond ETF (AGG)

events.reasoning: The escalation of the Iran war is expected to lead to increased volatility in the markets. The US and its allies are taking a strong stance against Iran, which could lead to further conflict. This could lead to a decrease in bond prices and an increase in stock prices.

timeFrame.note: Monitor the situation closely and adjust as needed

events.exitStrategy: Exit when the conflict is resolved or when the markets stabilize

gains.conservativeNote: If the conflict is resolved quickly
